topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I can't quite grasp how the air has turned so thin, how the light that was once a promise now flickers at the edges, uncertain. They said the party was cancelled, but the words don't settle, they float, meaningless. I walked through the house, each room echoing with the ghost of laughter that was supposed to fill it. The silence is thick, pressing, and I find myself rearranging chairs, smoothing out tablecloths, as if the change of a napkin could alter the course of what’s been decided. The phone lies still in my hand, a silent witness to the space where celebration should have been. I keep looking out the window, hoping for a car to arrive, for faces to appear, to break this strange spell of emptiness.
